NOTE: '97 Q1 earnings per share reflect an 18 percent reduction in the number of common shares outstanding following a series of stock buybacks and exchanges.

'96 Q1 results have been reclassified to reflect as discontinued operations the results of the three companies Maxco divested during the last fiscal year: FinishMaster Inc, Akemi Inc and Wright Plastic Products Inc. Reflecting the reclassification, Maxco would have reported income from continuing operations of $139,000, or 2 cents a share, in the 1996 first quarter.
'97 Q1 also includes equity in income of approximately $101,000 from Maxco's 20 percent owned Medar Inc.

'96 Q1 results have been restated to reflect the company's change to the equity method of accounting following its increased investment in Medar. The effect of the restatement was to increase net income for the three months ended June 30, 1996, by $115,000, or 3 cents a share.
